meta.name: understand-chat
meta.description: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用知识图谱问答代码库，快速理解代码结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解陌生代码库的结构和逻辑
copy.tagline_en: Query codebase with knowledge graph to understand code quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand the structure and logic of an unfamiliar codebase

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会读取项目里的知识图谱文件，按你的关键词搜索节点、关系和架构层，据此回答代码库问题，并指向具体文件、函数和所在层。
howto.when: 当你需要就代码库提问、或想借助知识图谱理解代码时触发。若项目根目录没有 `.understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json`，它会提示你先运行 `/understand`。

say.text: 这个项目的认证流程是怎么实现的？
UserService 依赖哪些模块，又被谁调用？
知识图谱里跟缓存相关的节点属于哪一层？
say.note: 结合 layers 说明所属架构层

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude reads the project's knowledge graph at .understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json, searches nodes, edges and layers for your keywords, and answers codebase questions with specific files, functions and layers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph. If the graph file is missing, it tells you to run /understand first.

say_en.text: How is the authentication flow implemented in this project?
What does UserService depend on, and what calls it?
Which architecture layer does the caching node belong to?
